configuration.backend_identity: exact pinned reference preset; CIX is integrated CIXB1 portfolio

exposure: The CIX gate previously processed these full CCA files. The cross-codec full-file measurements are new and settings were frozen before execution; results are exposed benchmark evidence, not an untouched holdout.
hypothesis: Full canonical-file results fill the CCA benchmark gap and compare the integrated CIXB1 selector with the six exact reference presets under each declared profile.
initial_state: empty at every repetition; one input-local stream; no carry between files
longer_budget_justification: Canonical input sizes are <=1.03 MiB. A five-minute cell allowance covers warmup, three complete physical archives and three independent archive-only decodes while the shared scheduler enforces 2 GB RAM, 100 MB temporary disk and zero swap.
matched_control: same complete canonical file hash and boundary; same-machine one-core execution; three independent encodes and archive-only decodes with one warmup
mechanism: original bytes directly through exact reference compressor; CIX uses the integrated bounded CIXB1 direct-backend + CIXG1 portfolio for files <=16 MiB
promotion_criteria: complete physical archive in each of three runs; all three source-inaccessible decodes byte-identical and SHA-256 equal; retain resource exclusions/timeouts; rank only verified results
resource_accounting: one physical core, 2 GB MemoryMax, 100 MB temporary directory cap, 300 s each encode/decode phase, MemorySwapMax=0
